versions.content: ControlDTCSetting Type: valid Description: The Diagnostic Extract shall support the configuration of UDS service 0x85 (ControlDTCSetting). Rationale: The service can be used to control the updating of status bits of diagnostic trouble codes in the server. Use Case: The user wants to either stop or resume the updating of status bits of diagnostic trouble codes in the server. Dependencies: – Supporting Material: More information about this diagnostic service can be found in the respective ISO specification [2].
